summary: Icon By Design is a Kensington NSW solid-timber furniture brand with showrooms in Sydney, Melbourne and, since October 2026, Brisbane. Hamilton Gong has been its accountant and business systems leader since September 2017 and describes himself as a data nerd who codes to improve systems. He appears to be the sole finance person for a multi-showroom AU/US business.

hooks.text: Brisbane showroom opened Oct 2026: a third store's takings and deposits join the close for a one-person finance function.
Hamilton owns both accounting and systems integration and likes coding, so a systems-minded pitch (traceable, no guessing) suits him.

risks.text: Single finance person who also owns systems; limited bandwidth and possible tool-evaluation caution.
Account record cites US showroom and 200% growth from a SmartCompany piece that I did not fetch; not cited.

gaps: No evidence of accounting stack (Xero, Shopify) from sources read.
SmartCompany growth article and Los Angeles showroom not verified.
